sub: In 1371, Cham forces sacked Thăng Long, the capital of Đại Việt.
say: In thirteen seventy-one, Chahm forces sacked Tahng Long, the capital of Dye Vee-et.

title: BOTH WAYS
sub: Wars between Champa and Đại Việt ran both ways. In 1069, a Vietnamese king had captured a Cham king.
say: Wars between Chahm-pah and Dye Vee-et ran both ways. In ten sixty-nine, a Vietnamese king had captured a Chahm king.

title: CHẾ BỒNG NGA
sub: Then the tide turned. In the late fourteenth century, a Cham king the Vietnamese called Chế Bồng Nga led attack after attack to the north.
say: Then the tide turned. In the late fourteenth century, a Chahm king the Vietnamese called Cheh Bong Ngah led attack after attack to the north.

title: 20 YEARS
sub: His campaigns went on for almost twenty years, until he was killed in battle in 1390.
say: His campaigns went on for almost twenty years, until he was killed in battle in thirteen ninety.

title: THREE SIDES
sub: Cham inscriptions, Vietnamese chronicles and Chinese records each tell these wars from their own side.
say: Chahm inscriptions, Vietnamese chronicles and Chinese records each tell these wars from their own side.

title: NAME UNKNOWN
sub: And his real Cham name is not known.
say: And his real Chahm name is not known.

title: AFTER HIM?
sub: So after he died, which way did the balance turn?
say: So after he died, which way did the balance turn?
